sections.summary: Herod Agrippa I kills the apostle James (brother of John) with the sword and arrests Peter during Passover, intending to execute him after the festival, while the church prays earnestly for Peter.

An angel rescues Peter from prison on the night before his scheduled execution -- chains fall off, gates open, and Peter is led past guards to freedom -- while the praying community initially cannot believe it when Peter arrives at their door.

sections.section_title: Herod's Death and the Word's Growth
sections.summary: Herod accepts divine acclamation ('the voice of a god, and not of a man'), is struck down by an angel of the Lord because he 'did not give God the glory,' and dies consumed by worms; the chapter closes with the summary 'the word of God increased and multiplied.'
